claim_boundary: Operation-valid and opcode activity is workload-incidence-derived. Operand toggles use an exact SPARTA value pool as a deterministic proxy, all streams assume continuously available inputs, and only top-level input nets are annotated. The generated SAIF is suitable for sensitivity screening, not workload energy or power claims.
